lines.text: Stablecoins can't lose their peg? USDC hit 87 cents.
lines.say: Stablecoins can't lose their peg? USDC hit eighty-seven cents.

lines.text: Mar 2023: Circle said $3.3 billion of USDC reserves sat at failed Silicon Valley Bank. USDC fell to about 87 cents on Mar 11.
lines.say: In March twenty twenty-three, three point three billion dollars of USDC's reserves were stuck at failed Silicon Valley Bank.

lines.text: Example: $1,000 of USDC x $0.87 = about $870 at the low. It was back near $1 by Mar 13, 2023.
lines.say: A thousand dollars of USDC was briefly worth about eight hundred seventy, before recovering two days later.

lines.text: TerraUSD (UST), backed by an algorithm and its sister token LUNA, fell to about 11 cents by May 16, 2022, and never recovered.
lines.say: TerraUSD ran on an algorithm, not cash, and sank to about eleven cents by May twenty twenty-two.

lines.text: Bank deposits: FDIC insured up to $250,000. Stablecoins: not FDIC insured.
lines.say: Bank deposits are insured up to two hundred fifty thousand dollars. Stablecoins aren't FDIC insured.

lines.text: The GENIUS Act (signed July 18, 2025) requires 1:1 reserves like cash and short-term Treasuries. It takes effect by Jan 18, 2027 at the latest.
lines.say: The GENIUS Act, signed July twenty twenty-five, requires one-to-one reserves like cash and short-term Treasuries, in force by January twenty twenty-seven.

lines.text: Dollar stablecoins outstanding: $27.1B at end of 2020 vs $306.7B at end of 2025 (DefiLlama).
lines.say: Dollar stablecoins grew from twenty-seven billion dollars in twenty twenty to about three hundred seven billion in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: A peg is only as strong as the reserves behind it, the ability to redeem, and honest reporting.
lines.say: So a peg is only as strong as its reserves, redemptions and honest reporting.

lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Stablecoins can't break? USDC hit 87 cents in March 2023
post.ig:
Stablecoins can't lose their peg? USDC hit about 87 cents.

Mar 11, 2023: Circle said $3.3B of USDC reserves sat at failed Silicon Valley Bank; USDC fell to about 87 cents, then recovered near $1 by Mar 13.
TerraUSD (UST), an algorithmic stablecoin, fell to about 11 cents by May 16, 2022 and never recovered.
Stablecoins are not FDIC insured. The GENIUS Act (signed July 18, 2025) requires 1:1 reserves and takes effect by Jan 18, 2027 at the latest.
Dollar stablecoins: $27.1B at end of 2020 vs $306.7B at end of 2025.

Sources: CNBC, CoinDesk, Reuters, FDIC, House Financial Services Committee, DefiLlama.
